cards.card_text: The altar gets its tools too: pots for the ashes, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.
cards.verse_text: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots for removing ashes, its shovels, its sprinkling bowls, its meat forks, and its firepans.
cards.snippet: …all its utensils of bronze—its pots for removing ashes, its shovels, its sprinkling bowls, its meat forks, and its firepans.

cards.card_text: All the altar's utensils are bronze too: pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.
cards.verse_text: He made all the altar’s utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks, and firepans.
cards.snippet: He made all the altar’s utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks, and firepans.

cards.card_text: He also makes ten stands on wheels with a basin for each, plus pots, shovels and sprinkling bowls.
cards.verse_text: Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls.
cards.snippet: Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls.

cards.card_text: Silver basins, sprinkling bowls, trumpets, articles of gold.
cards.verse_text: However, the money brought into the house of the LORD was not used for making silver basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or any articles of gold or silver for the house of the LORD.
cards.snippet: …of the LORD was not used for making silver basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or any articles of gold or silver for the house…

cards.card_text: Last comes the rest in purest gold: flowers, lamps, tongs, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, censers, and the gold doors to the Most Holy Place and the main hall.
cards.verse_text: the flowers, lamps, and tongs of gold—of purest gold; the wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers of pure gold; and the gold doors of the temple: the inner doors to the Most Holy Place as well as the doors of the main hall.
cards.snippet: the flowers, lamps, and tongs of gold—of purest gold; the wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers of pure gold; and the gold doors of…

cards.card_text: The LORD's people will be filled like sprinkling bowls.
cards.verse_text: And they will be filled like sprinkling bowls, drenched like the corners of the altar.
cards.snippet: And they will be filled like sprinkling bowls, drenched like the corners of the altar.

cards.card_text: The sprinkling bowls before the altar The water jars beside the well The clay jars in the storeroom
cards.verse_text: On that day, HOLY TO THE LORD will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, and the cooking pots in the house of the LORD will be like the sprinkling bowls before the altar.
cards.snippet: …cooking pots in the house of the LORD will be like the sprinkling bowls before the altar.

cards.card_text: By faith Moses keeps the Passover and the sprinkling of blood.
cards.verse_text: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn.
cards.snippet: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch…

cards.card_text: The Passover and the sprinkling of blood kept the destroyer from touching Israel's own firstborn.
cards.verse_text: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn.
cards.snippet: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch…

cards.card_text: Peter adds that this was for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood.
cards.verse_text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
cards.snippet: …Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
